title: Airtable update wipes every field that was not in the request
symptoms: Other fields on the record are blank after an update
airtable.js replace() clears columns that update() left alone
Data loss only on records touched by one integration
cause: A PUT to the records endpoint is a destructive update that clears every cell not included. airtable.js replace() sends PUT, while update() sends PATCH.
fix: Use PATCH (update() in airtable.js) for partial changes, and reserve PUT for writes that send the full record.
apply: await base("Contacts").update([{ id: rec.id, fields: { Status: "Won" } }]); // PATCH, other fields kept
affected: Airtable Web API; airtable.js 0.12.2 and earlier
